Plan, measure, and manage

Work the way you want, establish service-level agreements, control employee access, and make data-driven decisions using customizable dashboards & analytics

Improve Efficiency

Make your entire team wildly productive by eliminating time-consuming, manual sourcing, scheduling, screening, and reporting tasks.

Engage and Impress Everyone

Delight candidates, managers, recruiters, and interviewers with tailored personalized experiences. Drive adoption with onboarding checklists.

Get Started

Click less and recruit more

Powerful automation frees you up to do more strategic, impactful work. Candidate scoring zeros in on who’s qualified.

Low-effort candidate pipeline

Execute every tactic: post on job boards, employee referral campaigns, rediscover talent, manage search firms, and more.

A single source of truth

Make transparency and shared accountability the new normal by connecting everyone’s email, calendar, and more.

Get Started

Self-schedule interviews

Send scheduling requests with 1 click. Monitor scheduling status. Automatically send interview reminders.

Master calendar Tetris

Set preferred interviewers and scorecards per job. Easily juggle multiple people’s free/busy. Send perfect invites with complete interview panel data.

Run reports with 1 click

Stop spending hours updating spreadsheets. Save and bookmark self-service reports & share them in no time flat.

Get Started

Search, tag, and filter

Search candidates and notes with boolean operators. Save searches. Score candidates. Add and edit tags.

LinkedIn Recruiter System Connect

Synchronize data between LinkedIn Recruiter and JobScore. Save up to 3 hours a week by streamlining workflows.

Integrate any tool

Add resumes one by one, in bulk, or by simply sending an email. Integrate 3rd party sourcing tools using the JobScore Hire API.

Get Started

DE&I, compliance, & internal mobility

Securely collect and analyze gender, race, disability, and veteran status data. Use diversity questions and insights to meet goals. Promote mobility with an internal job board.

Connect to leading HRIS & onboarding platforms

Integrate JobScore with your preferred HRIS and Onboarding platform. Eliminate data entry and create a seamless hiring experience.

Powerful recruiting features when you need them

If you have recruiting responsibility, leverage powerful features for sourcing, coordinating, full cycle recruiting, and talent acquisition leadership.

Get Started

Easy job & offer approvals

Use powerful, customizable, multi-step, mobile-optimized approval chains to control when jobs can be opened and job offer terms.

Visibility & metrics

Easily see what’s open, how things are going, and whether KPIs are trending up or down.

Never miss a trick

Avoid recruiting bottlenecks by customizing alerts and accessing JobScore from your mobile device.

Get Started

See your pipeline at a glance

Access the real-time information you need about every job and candidate from anywhere.

Your process, your way

Maximize your chance of hiring top performers by working the way you want, as a team, on a job-by-job basis. Customize workflow steps, hiring team members, forms, interview questions, and more.

Only log in if you want to

If you don’t want to log in over the web or mobile, easily work from your email and JobScore keeps everything in sync.

Get Started

Easily run great interviews

Everything you need on one page: a formatted resume, the job description, video conferencing link, questions, rating criteria, interview panel details, and more.

Share or apply for open jobs

See every open job at your company and either apply yourself or help recruit by sharing jobs on social networks or by email.

Make referrals and track their progress

Refer people for jobs, share what makes them great for a role, and then track how they move through the recruiting process.

Get Started

Security & Compliance

JobScore is hosted in the Amazon cloud and is SOC2 Type II compliant. We help our customers meet EEO, OFCCP, GRPR, CCPA, and other compliance regulations.

SSO & Pre-built Integrations

Make it easy for your team to securely log in without a password using Google, Microsoft, OpenID, or SAML. Easily connect email, calendar, conferencing, HRIS platforms, and more.

APIs, Webhooks, and more

Build any integration you need with webhooks, the Hire API, and Zapier. Build custom data visualizations using our business Intelligence connector and your favorite reporting platform.

Get Started

Promote your employment brand

Impress candidates and provide a window into your culture with images, videos, maps, and team profiles. Customize your theme to match your logo and brand.

Craft Impressive Experiences

Provide candidates with a modern, impressive experience from start to finish: job descriptions, job application forms, emails, forms, offers, and more.

Be Responsive and Polite

Combine candidate scoring with automatic correspondence tracking, overdue alerts, and email templates to provide timely, polite responses.

Get Started
